title: Original Cave Spider Texture
description: Reverts the Cave Spider texture to the original.
body:
## Original Cave Spider Texture Resource Pack

Changes the current Texture for the Cave Spider into the original Cave Spider texture. A true work of art that was ripped away from players for no reason! Trading the washed out texture for the newer one that is simply a lot cooler! (In my opinion)

![The better cave spider. A cooler shade of blue, with tan-ish highlights that creates a really cool color pallet that contrasts well with the bright red eyes. VS. Thecurrent texture where the colors are washed out](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/af72fe74d4f394eaa2724f52fbc284ba58f43fc5.png)

Youtube Video Showcase (On my second channel)
<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/80gt507Df8A" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>

## What this Resource Pack Does:
- Replaces the cave spider texture with the old one
- Makes cave spiders look cool beans

## Things to note:
- **In game it will say it is outdated. Ignore that it still works just fine. I am not sure how to fix that but it should be fine either way, just let me know if it ever stops working. :)**
- This was put together in just a few hours and was fueled by pure spite
- This project is not affiliated in any way with Mojang or Microsoft
- Everything said in this description is meant to be light-hearted jokey jokes.

I did edit the texture a bit so the body wouldn't be solid black like it usually is but! Yeah that's it. I don't think anyone is looking for a texture pack like this but if you are I hope you enjoy it!

I made this texture pack because apparently I'm the only one looking for something like this.! Couldn't find anyone making this pack themself lol.

-SpiderbeansMC

P.S. I make fun Minecraft videos! Check me out if you find this useful! https://www.youtube.com/@SpiderbeansMC
